title: A Turn off refused during a failed erase leaves reminders shown on though the server row is cancelled
evidence: standalone/reminders.ts:397 ignores setReminderOptIn's false. Turn off pressed, then Delete all my data confirmed while the cancel is out, and the erase fails (its cloud read fails): the write is refused because the session is erasing, the server row is cancelled, but the record and the screen keep reminders on with no error until a later push gets a 404 and flips them (US-11 AC4b residual). Options: read the opt-in again and show the true state, or push again. Found by the PR 1664 adversary
